Kelp, seagrass, lily pads, corals and the water plants of other mods (Fintastic, Regions Unexplored, Twilight Forest, Alex's Caves; data/<ns>/bettacraft/foreign_plants) placed in the tank interior lower the nitrate and the waste, count as plants for breeding, hiding, the small animals and the oxygen, floating leaves give shade, live rock of other mods is a small biological filter in salt water; like a full-grown plant of ours of the same growth form times interiorPlants.foreignPlantFactor, without growth and without needs (off: they are decoration only)

The aquarium net now and then brings up an aquarium plant from the bottom of rivers, jungle water and swamps (interiorPlants.netPlantShare; off: plants only from fishing, bottles, shears and the trader)

Every aquarium plant grows wild in the waters of its origin (new chunks; jungle water, swamps, rivers, mangroves, cold lakes, lush caves); shears cut a cutting off them (spawn.wildPlantFrequency; off: no new ones in new chunks, plants already there stay)
bettacraft.configuration.features.bettas: Bettas (Betta splendens and the wild species): the betta items and their recipes, wild bettas, bettas from the net and the trader; the betta care rests. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Wild bettas spawn in swamps (spawn.weight, spawn.minGroupSize, spawn.maxGroupSize) (off: no wild bettas)

Wild bettas: some wild bettas in swamps are Betta imbellis or Betta smaragdina instead of Betta splendens; they cross with each other and with Betta splendens into fertile hybrids (off: only Betta splendens in the wild; fish already caught stay)
bettacraft.configuration.features.bigTan: Big animals: giant catfish, sharks, rays and the vanilla dolphin in big tanks by the size rule (bigAnimalRules.*), the large net, the transport tub and the steel leader, wild big animals (off: none go into tanks, no new ones from the wild; those in tanks stay)

Big tanks: up to bigTankRules.bigMaxSize* blocks (32 x 16 x 32), with a smaller interior scale (8 or 4) from bigTankRules.interiorScale8Above (off: tank.maxSize* as before; big tanks already built stay) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.bracki: Amano shrimp (Caridina multidentata): strong algae eaters; the females carry eggs in fresh water, but the larvae only grow up in brackish water: net them into a fish bag and move them into a brackish tank, after a few days young shrimp come out (phytoplankton helps); the young go back into fresh water (off: no new ones; their larvae die)

The archerfish (Toxotes jaculatrix) of the mangroves: it shoots insects above the water down with a jet of water (fruit flies let out over the tank, insects at the plants above an open tank) and now and then splashes a player who leans over the tank (harmless); at the wandering trader, in the net and wild in mangrove swamps (off: no new ones, it does not shoot)

The brackish water animals and plants of the mangroves: archerfish, mudskipper, mangroves in the interior and Amano shrimp with their brackish larvae. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Mangroves in the tank interior: a mangrove propagule on the tank grows into a small mangrove with stilt roots that reaches over the water surface, and the stilt root decoration (off: no new ones, they stop growing)

The mudskipper (Periophthalmus) in a brackish paludarium: a fish that lives on the mud, needs land and water and climbs on roots; from the terrarium box in mangrove swamps and the wandering trader (off: none go into tanks, none are sold; those in tanks stay)
bettacraft.configuration.features.breedi: Breeding of every animal in the tanks: bettas, tankmates, small animals, frogs, turtles, amphibians and reptiles and the animals of other mods; breeding box, spawning caves and mops, fry powder. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Motor filters without an intake sponge suck in the young of fish, shrimp and tadpoles (not snails) now and then (internalFilters.fryIntakePerDay) (off: no young animal is sucked in)
The hidden genes of a new animal are unknown until it is analysed with the magnifier in a tank (off: every animal shows its genes like before)
Spontaneous mutations also for shrimp, crayfish, snails and the tankmates without their own genetics (off: only bettas, guppies and endlers mutate)
Now and then a wild animal shows a bred colour openly (wildlife.beautifulWildChance; off: wild animals are wild-coloured, bred colours only hidden)
bettacraft.configuration.features.co2.en: CO2 dosing: bio CO2, gas cylinders with pressure regulator and solenoid valve, the CO2 filling station; CO2 makes the plants grow faster, lowers the pH and too much harms the animals (off: the devices give no CO2) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.compat: Integration with Better Fish Tanks: our filled fish bag and the betta bucket release their animal into a Better Fish Tanks tank.

A cabinet under a tank takes a Create shaft on the side set in its menu (createDrive.cabinetSides lists the sides allowed): it charges the tank's FE buffer like a drive adapter, and with power.winding on what the tank does not need winds the cabinet's spring (off: the cabinet takes no shaft; its setting is kept)

Tanks travel on Create contraptions (pistons, bearings, pulleys, gantries, carts, trains) and on Create Aeronautics airships: the animals are packed into the tank for the trip (on airships they swim on, see travelCare), everything comes back where the tank is put down (off: Create cannot move tanks; a tank that is already travelling still unpacks)

Tanks and monitors are sources for Create's Display Link: the values of a tank, or one line per tank a monitor shows, on display boards, nixie tubes, signs and lecterns (off: Display Links cannot read them)

The drive adapter (only with Create): set on a tank wall or under a tank, a Create shaft at it charges the tank's FE buffer, so every device of the tank that takes the tank's FE runs on rotation (filters, flow pumps and skimmers, heaters, coolers and heat mats, lights, air pumps, misters); 64 RPM for the full power, slower proportionally, several adapters add up to a limit. It costs real stress (SU) by the load of the devices; an overstressed network gives nothing (off: no drive adapters, the cabinet shaft is off too; the FE in the buffer stays)

Integration with Create (and Create Aeronautics): tanks on contraptions, rotation for the devices, Display Links, the stainless steel mixing recipe. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Create's rotation drives the water pumps, filter pump head, water change controller, level sensor, reverse osmosis unit, food maker and fertilizer maker instead of FE: a shaft or cogwheel pointing at the device, 64 RPM for full work, slower proportionally; no stress cost (off: only FE, the crank and the other sources as before)

Tanks keep living while they travel. On Create Aeronautics airships (Sable) the animals stay real and swim in the tank, the care, breeding and every device on the ship run as on the ground (power from Create generators, drive adapters and batteries on the ship). On Create contraptions (pistons, bearings, carts, trains) the tank data is simulated: hunger and health of the animals, temperature, water quality and the filters, heaters and coolers that travel along, powered from the tank's buffer, FE batteries of the contraption next to the tank and drive adapters that turn with the trip; breeding pauses there (off: the care pauses during the trip as before, the animals travel packed)
Integration with EnderIO: the stainless steel recipe of its alloy smelter.
The Bettacraft handbook through GuideME (off: no handbook item and no handbook pages).
Integration with JEI (and EMI / REI through JEI): our recipe categories, info pages and the hidden items of features that are off.

A monitor alarm or a warning of the hired aquarist puts a waypoint at its tank on the map of the tank's owner and its listed users (JourneyMap, Xaero's Minimap, FTB Chunks); it goes away when the alarm clears. The users tab of the tank turns it on or off per tank and per user, the client config per player and per map mod (off: no waypoints)
Integration with Mekanism: the stainless steel recipe of its metallurgic infuser.

Bettacraft posts its events for modpack scripts (KubeJS NativeEvents) and other mods on the NeoForge event bus: an animal was born or hatched in a tank, an animal of a tank died (with the cause), an alarm tile of a monitor went off or cleared (off: none are posted)
The lines of tanks, bettas, filters and cultures in the overlay mods Jade, The One Probe and WTHIT (compat.overlayProvider picks which one).
Integration with Thermal Expansion: the stainless steel recipe of its induction smelter.
bettacraft.configuration.features.corals: Corals and the bubble tip anemone in salt water tanks: frags from the trader, the net and vanilla corals, wild corals on the reefs (needs saltwater.enabled). Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Reef dosing: alkalinity (KH), magnesium and trace elements in salt water, used up by the stony corals, and the dosing pump with up to four canisters (off: the values stand still and the pump does not dose)
Every Bettacraft coral and the bubble tip anemone grow on the warm ocean coral reefs (new chunks); shears cut a frag off them (off: no new ones in new chunks)
Bigger, more detailed dino skull and shipwreck decoration (off: the small old shapes for newly placed ones)

Almond leaves and alder cones on the floor of a tank interior give off tannins (lower the pH a little) and feed the shrimp; clay and terracotta (tubes, caves, dragon stone) hide young shrimp (off: they are only decoration)

The tank decoration (castle, caves, roots, stones, wrecks and the rest of the decor items) and its recipes. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.equipm: Equipment
Aeration
Air pump with air stones in the tank interior: bubble columns, more oxygen (off: they cannot be placed and placed ones do nothing)
Several animals per bucket and bag

Several animals of one species per bucket and fish bag by their size (a bucket: 32 shrimp, 24 rasboras, 1 betta; a bag half of that), small animals also in a plain bucket (off: one fish per bucket, bags as before)
Break protection
Break protection switch in the tank menu: nobody can break a protected tank, its lid, light, feeders and the cabinet below (off: the switch is hidden and does nothing)
Cabinets under the whole tank

Cabinets join to the back as well, so a whole area under a big tank (e.g. 10 x 5) becomes one under-cabinet: the front row shows the fronts, the cabinets behind it a plain carcass with the counter top and the sides running through; the middle may be normal blocks. A cabinet placed against the side or back of another takes its facing (off: cabinets join only left and right, every cabinet shows its front and faces the way it was placed)
Cabinet fronts

Cabinets side by side show one front: drawers at both ends, double doors over two blocks between them, a single door in the middle of an odd row; the button "Front" in the cabinet menu fixes the front of one cabinet (double door left or right, single door, drawers, two doors) and switches the dark joints between the doors (off: every cabinet shows its two doors like before, the button is hidden, the setting is kept)
Outlet side of the cabinet filter

Setting in the cabinet menu: on which tank wall the hose of the external filter in the cabinet goes up (back, left, right, front); jet, bubbles and the current follow it, in front of the outlet the water moves faster (seahorses, corals) (off: always the back wall, the current evenly like before)
Catch guard

After catching an animal no container lets an animal go for half a second, so a second click of a bouncing mouse button or a held key does not release it again at once (off: no pause; the confirmation before letting animals go into the world stays)
Clip-on feeder
Clip-on feeder: a small automatic feeder that hangs on the side of the glass (for tanks whose top is taken by a light) (off: it cannot be placed and placed ones do not feed)
External filter below the tank

The external filter can also stand one or two blocks lower than the tank (beside the cabinet or without one); sneak-right-click it with an empty hand to choose the tank from a list, the hose goes up the longer way. A filter right next to a tank connects by itself as before (off: only filters right next to a tank work; a chosen tank below is kept for later)
Filter media by automation

Hoppers, pipes and the buses of ME and RS put a fresh filter medium into an empty chamber of the multiblock filter and take a used-up medium (fully clogged or spent) out; a medium that still works stays in (off: media only by hand)
LED tiers

Stronger aquarium lights: the LED panel (2 blocks wide) and the high-power LED (any size); stronger light makes red plants redder, lets the strong-light plants grow and brings more algae (off: the new lights count like the light bar)
Light bar on a lid

The aquarium light bar can lie directly on a tank lid: put it onto the top of a lid (or a lid under a bar standing on a tank); the lid stays under the bar in the same block, the tank counts as covered and gets the light. Breaking it gives back both (off: no new bar goes onto a lid; bars already on lids stay)
Dimmer and daylight timer
Dimmer and daylight timer with sunrise and sunset for the lights of a tank (tank menu, tab Devices) (off: lights are on at full strength like before)
More internal filters
The air-driven sponge filter (gentle, needs an air pump), the corner filter and the intake sponge for motor filters (off: they cannot be placed or fitted and placed ones do not clean)
Multiblock external filter
Multiblock external filter from filter chambers, a pump head and connectors, with filter media that clog and must be cleaned (off: it does not clean)
Stainless steel
Crucible and stainless steel (also from the machines of Mekanism, EnderIO, Create and Thermal) (off: the crucible does not melt)
Stone cabinets

Stone cabinets: the aquarium cabinet can also be crafted from stone (also of other mods) with the slabs of the same stone; it looks like that stone and is mined with a pickaxe (off: no new ones can be crafted; placed ones stay)
Tank users

The users tab of the tank menu: the owner (who built the tank) lists other players as caretakers (may do everything the owner may) or viewers (see the menu, change nothing, cannot go into the tank); everybody else is decided by the lock (off: the list is ignored and hidden, only the owner and the lock count like before)
bettacraft.configuration.features.fertil: The dosing pump also doses liquid fertilizer from a fertilizer canister, into fresh and salt water tanks (off: fertilizer canisters do nothing)

Liquid fertilizer and the fertilizer maker: fertilizer in the water speeds up the growth of Bettacraft's aquarium and floating plants (not the plants of other mods), the plants use it up, water changes dilute it, too much makes the algae grow faster (off: the fertilizer does nothing and the maker stands still) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.floati: Floating plants on the water surface of the tanks (duckweed, frogbit, salvinia, red root floater, water lettuce): from bottles, fishing, the trader and the wild. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Every floating plant grows wild on the waters of its origin (new chunks); picked up by hand or with the net (spawn.wildPlantFrequency; off: no new ones in new chunks, plants already there stay)
bettacraft.configuration.features.foodMa: Food maker: makes pellets, flakes, granules, wafers, fry powder, shrimp food and frozen food from vanilla ingredients and live food, with a wound spring or FE (off: it stands still) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.foodVa: Food variety: favourite and poor food per species, a varied diet speeds up the recovery and shows in the colours of the bettas (off: every food is the same) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.foreig: Axolotl care: vanilla axolotls in a tank want cool water (15-20 °C, a cooler), suffer in warm water and breed there: eggs on the plants, larvae as baby axolotls, the five colours inherited by Mendel (blue recessive and rare; off: axolotls in tanks are left to vanilla)
Breeding of animals of other mods

Breeding of animals of other mods in our tanks by their profile: livebearers give birth, egg layers spawn (some on plants, food fish only in big tanks); the young take the variants of their parents (off: they do not breed in our tanks)
Care for animals of other mods

Care for animals of other mods: the fish and water animals of other mods that have a profile (data/<ns>/bettacraft/foreign_animals, defaults for Fintastic, Aquaculture, Critters and Companions and Naturalist) get our needs in our tanks: hunger, temperature, water quality, salinity, pH/TDS, stress, sickness and death (off: they are left to their mod as before; outside our tanks nothing changes either way)

Vanilla animals (axolotls) and the animals of other mods in our tanks: our care and breeding for them by their profiles. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Suppress the own breeding of vanilla and mod animals in our tanks (love from food, breeding goals, babies of their mod), so only our breeding applies there (off: their mod may breed them in the tank as well)
Land and marsh animals of other mods

Land and marsh animals of other mods with a terrarium profile (defaults: the Naturalist tortoise and alligator) in terraria and paludaria (they also need features.terrariums.enabled): by the size rule of the big animals over the land, the water or the whole tank, moved by our walker, fed land food by hand and from the feeder, eggs into sand or soil; the terrarium box catches them and the animals of terrarium.boxAllow (off: none go into tanks and the box takes none; those in tanks stay)

The peaceful animals of Minecraft live in terraria and paludaria by their profiles (minecraft_*.json): chickens, rabbits, bees, frogs, cats, ocelots, foxes, parrots, armadillos, bats and wolves, and pigs, sheep, goats, cows, mooshrooms, horses, donkeys, mules, llamas, pandas and polar bears as big animals by the size rule; moved by our walker, fed by hand and from the feeder, with needs of their own (bees: flowers and a beehive in the interior; rabbits and the grazers: grass; frogs: a paludarium), chicks from eggs in the sand and young of their own; caught with the terrarium box, the large net and the tub or with bait; they drop nothing and give no wool, milk or eggs (off: none go in and the box takes none, the refusals of camels, sniffers, striders and the undead horses are off too; those in tanks stay)
Breeding of the dwarf clawed frogs: a cool water change into a tank at 24-28 °C sets a pair off (amplexus); the spawn floats at the surface (fish and bettas eat it, floating plants hide it), the tadpoles need infusoria or other fine food and become frogs after a few days (off: no new spawn; spawn and tadpoles already there still grow)

Dwarf clawed frogs (Hymenochirus): in tanks, from the net, the trader and the wild. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Wild dwarf clawed frogs spawn in swamps and jungle water, rarely (spawn.wildFishWeight) (off: only the net, the trader and breeding bring them)
bettacraft.configuration.features.interi: Deletes what the interiors of broken, grown, split, merged and turned tanks leave on the disk after the next save of the world (their chunks while the game runs, their region files at the next start; a log line with count and size first) and hands their numbers out again; empty interior chunks are not stored at all; the interiors of standing, packed and travelling tanks are never touched (off: everything stays on the disk as before; /bettacraft interior cleanup still works for operators)

The interior of the tanks (a pocket dimension at 16 blocks per tank block) and its miniature in the tank: going in, the equipment and plants placed in there. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Path finding in the tank interior: dwarf frogs walk around decoration, small animals go under overhangs and into caves, plecos swim into their spawning cave (off: straight lines like before)
bettacraft.configuration.features.invert: List of every single shrimp, crayfish and snail in the tank menu (sex, age, colour density, genes) to take out exactly that one, and the sex choice for the quick take-out (off: only the kinds like before)

Big crayfish: the Florida crayfish (wild, blue, orange) and the marbled crayfish (only females, multiplies on its own) at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild; they eat plants, dig them up and catch slow fish and small animals (off: no new ones; those in tanks stay)
Caridina bee shrimp (Crystal Red, Crystal Black, Taiwan bees, Tiger) for soft water, with their banding grades (off: no new ones from the net, the wild and the trader; those in tanks stay)

The small animals: shrimp, snails, crayfish and hermit crabs in the tanks, from the net, the shovel, the trader and the wild. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Snail colours: every nerite gets its own random shade (red and yellow racer nerites), apple snails are mostly gold with shades and bands, ramshorn snails also come in red (off: one fixed colour per variety, brown apple snails, no new red ramshorns)
Sulawesi animals: cardinal shrimp and Tylomelania snails for hard, warm water (off: no new ones from the net, the wild and the trader; those in tanks stay)
Wild small animals in the world

Wild shrimp, crayfish, snails and hermit crabs crawl on the bottom of rivers, swamps, mangroves, beaches, jungle water and warm oceans; caught with the net, a fish bag or a bucket, and they can be let go again (off: they do not spawn, and let go into the world they are gone like before)
bettacraft.configuration.features.liveFo: Live food cultures: the tubifex dish (mud, mulm or waste water) and the daphnia barrel (yeast or green water, light), harvested with the net or by hoppers and pumps (off: the cultures stand still)

Live food: mosquito larvae, infusoria, artemia, tubifex, daphnia, crickets and fruit flies, their breeders and cultures. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Live food pump: pumps daphnia, artemia and other live food from a breeder through the pipes into tanks on a schedule (off: it does not pump and tanks take no live food from pipes)
bettacraft.configuration.features.mobsIn: Mobs in glass: drowned, zombies, husks, skeletons, strays, spiders, cave spiders, silverfish, endermites and small slimes and magma cubes live shrunk and harmless in tanks (mob jar, bait, capture items of other mods); they drop nothing (off: none go in; those in tanks stay) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.monito: Monitors: screens of monitor blocks that show the values of every tank in range, with graphs of the last days (off: the screens stay dark and record nothing) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.osmosi: Reverse osmosis unit: makes reverse osmosis water (nothing dissolved) from water, with a membrane and a prefilter that wear out (off: it does not run) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Water change controller: changes a part of the water by itself at an interval (off: it does nothing)

Glass and stainless steel pipes and the water pump: they carry water with its values between tanks, filters and the tanks and pipes of other mods (off: pipes carry nothing and pumps stand still) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Pipes at the inlet and outlet of the multiblock filter are its intake and return line (blue and orange rings), with branches to every tank they reach: one filter serves several tanks (its cleaning and flow are shared by their water volumes, a line carries at most what its weakest pipe carries); the pipes dock on any side, the top or the bottom of a tank, with their connection in the interior; every connection needs an intake or outlet guard there, also on filters built before (off: a filter serves one tank as before, without guards, and its lines carry nothing)

A level sensor and a water change controller that touch the multiblock filter top off and change the water of all its tanks (shared by what each tank needs) (off: the devices on the filter work as before, on one tank)

Bulkhead in the tank floor and pipes, intake strainer, lily pipe, nozzle and spray bar in the tank interior; their current acts where they sit (off: they cannot be placed and the bulkheads stay closed)

Pipe covers on the pipes and pipe bundles: with the pipe cover in the main hand and a full block in the off hand, right-click a pipe and it is drawn as that block (sneak-right-click with the pipe cover takes it off again, the block comes back); the pipe keeps its connections. The facades of Applied Energistics 2, EnderIO and Mekanism Covers go on them too (off: no new covers go on, covers already on stay and can be taken off)

The pipe wrench: right-click a side of a pipe to close it (the pipe no longer joins what is there, a cap shows it) or open it again, also on one pipe of a bundle; sneak-right-click on a bundle moves the pipe you look at to the next spot (off: the wrench does nothing; closed sides stay closed)
Top-off: a level sensor tops off evaporated water from a reservoir or a pipe (off: it does nothing)
Joined cabinets add to the tank's store

Cabinets joined to the cabinets under a tank (side by side at the same height, under no other tank) belong to that tank: each adds power.storePerCabinet to the tank's energy store, and the crank at any of them charges it (off: only the cabinets right under the tank count)

Devices use Forge Energy (FE) from cables and batteries of other mods (off: the devices run without power). Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Power regulator 0-100 % on filters, air stones, air pumps and flow pumps (menu or sneak + mouse wheel): less power cleans and moves less, needs less FE and is quieter (off: everything runs at 100 %)

M67: the crank at a cabinet under a tank or at an external filter attached to it charges the tank's one energy store (power.crankFePerClick a click), the same store that FE cables charge; it runs every device of the tank (off: only FE charges a tank)

With power.costs EASY or HARD the multiblock filter, the reverse osmosis unit, the water change controller and the water pump can be wound with the crank instead of FE; the food maker and the fertilizer maker take FE or their spring. FE goes first (off: with power costs these devices only run on FE, and the crank does not charge a tank's store)
bettacraft.configuration.features.saltwa: Salt water tanks: sea salt, sea water, salinity, protein skimmer, live and reef rock, reef fish and reef animals. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Clownfish larvae and their food chain

Clownfish larvae and their food chain: the larvae drift for a few days after hatching and need rotifers in the tank (later also artemia nauplii); phytoplankton keeps the rotifers alive; phytoplankton and rotifer cultures in a bottle. Without rotifers only a few larvae survive (reef.clownLarvaSurvival) (off: the young swim free after one larva day as before, no cultures)

More reef animals: the mandarin (lives on the copepods of the live rock, takes no other food), the Banggai cardinalfish (the male broods the eggs in his mouth), the lyretail anthias (a shoal, fed often) and the fire shrimp at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild in warm oceans (off: no new ones; their care rests, animals already caught stay)
Reef fish (clownfish, tangs, gobies, damsels) at the trader, in the net and wild in warm oceans (needs tankmates.enabled) (off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)

Seahorses (lined seahorse Hippocampus erectus, dwarf seahorse H. zosterae) at the wandering trader and in the aquarium net in warm and lukewarm oceans (off: no new ones; seahorses already caught stay)
bettacraft.configuration.features.sounds: The sounds of the devices: filters, air pump, air stones, sponge filter, flow pump, feeder and the bubbling of the tanks (off: the devices are silent; sounds.useVanilla picks the vanilla sounds instead). Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.source: The villager profession Aquarist: an unemployed villager next to a breeding basin becomes one; he sells plants, floating plants, food, shrimp, snails, test kits and substrate, on the master level rare tankmate varieties, and buys bettas and bred tankmates for emeralds by their genes (data/<ns>/bettacraft/aquarist_prices.json) (off: no new aquarists, aquarists lose their profession and their offers, the breeding basin cannot be crafted)
bettacraft.configuration.features.sump.c: Calcium reactor: a block next to a salt water tank (or the cabinet of its sump, or on a pipe) that dissolves coral rubble with CO2 from a gas cylinder and raises calcium and alkalinity (KH) for the stony corals, the other way besides the dosing pump (off: it stands still)
bettacraft.configuration.features.sump.e: The sump: a tank in the cabinet under a tank that adds its water to the tank (the values change more slowly, room for more animals) and holds the heaters, a protein skimmer and filter media in its chambers; a level sensor or dosing pump next to the cabinet serves the tank above. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
bettacraft.configuration.features.sump.r: Refugium: a chamber of the sump with Chaetomorpha algae and a light of its own; the algae take up nitrate and starve the algae on the glass, they grow and are harvested as food or fertilizer (off: the chamber does nothing, the algae stand still)
bettacraft.configuration.features.tankma: Tankmate fish
Barbs and loaches
Barbs and loaches: tiger, odessa and cherry barb, dwarf chain loach, reticulated loach and garra at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild (off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
Cichlids

Cichlids: ram, Bolivian ram, cockatoo and Agassiz's dwarf cichlid, angelfish and discus at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild (open brooders and cave brooders that guard their brood; off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
More community fish

More community fish: zebra danio, celestial pearl danio, forktail and neon dwarf rainbowfish, emperor, rummy-nose and black phantom tetra, black molly and swordtail at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild (off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
Tankmate fish

The tankmate fish (tetras, rasboras, corydoras, plecos, loaches, livebearers, gouramis and the later groups): in tanks, from the net, the trader and the wild. Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Gouramis

Gouramis: honey, chocolate and pearl gourami at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild (labyrinth fish; foam nests, the chocolate gourami broods in her mouth; off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
Green neon tetra
Green neon tetra (Paracheirodon simulans, blue and green form) at the wandering trader and in the aquarium net (off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
Guppy and endler genetics

Guppy and endler genetics: every guppy and endler has its own genes (tail shape, body and tail colour, patterns on the X and Y chromosome) that are inherited at birth, named strains, endler x guppy hybrids (off: the old fixed varieties; the genes are kept)
More bottom fish

More bottom fish: the bronze corydoras (Corydoras aeneus: wild, albino, gold laser) and the panda garra (Garra flavatra) at the wandering trader, the aquarist, in the aquarium net and wild (off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
Puffers

Puffers: dwarf puffer, red-eye puffer and the brackish green spotted puffer at the wandering trader, in the aquarium net and wild (they eat snails, nip fins and need snails or hard food for their teeth; off: no new ones; fish already caught stay)
Bred forms of tetras and corydoras

Bred forms of tetras and corydoras: diamond, gold and albino neon, gold cardinal, albino glowlight, albino and (rarely) longfin panda cory, albino sterbai, albino and gold laser bronze cory at the trader and hidden in wild fish (off: these species only come in the wild form; fish already bred keep their forms)
Schools in the wild
Shoaling fish outside a tank (wild ones and ones let go) swim as a school: they follow a leader of their kind like in a tank instead of each wandering alone (M62) (off: every fish swims for itself)
Wild tankmates spawn
Wild tankmate fish and seahorses spawn in their biomes, rarely and in small shoals (spawn.wildFishWeight) (off: only the net, the trader and breeding bring them)
bettacraft.configuration.features.terrar: Terrarium plants
Dart frog tadpoles in bromeliads

Dart frogs carry their tadpoles into the water cups of grown bromeliads (one per bromeliad): there they need no open water and no food and leave as froglets; the rest go into the water as before (off: every tadpole goes into the water)
Terrarium plants

Terrarium and paludarium plants: bromeliads, ferns, mosses, orchids, carnivorous plants, sedges, cacti and succulents grow on the land of a terrarium or paludarium by its light, humidity and air temperature, spread, raise the humidity and give cuttings, offsets or divisions; they can be planted in the world as decoration (they grow only in a tank) (off: they rest in the tanks and cannot be planted) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Snakes and geckos hide in plants
Snakes and geckos hide among the grown terrarium plants of their tank (bromeliads, ferns, grasses, succulents) besides under the decoration (off: only under the decoration)
Tortoises graze

Tortoises graze the edible terrarium plants of their tank (prickly pear, stonecrop and the grasses) when they are hungry: a grown plant loses a stage and the tortoise is fed (off: they eat only what they are given)
Wild terrarium plants

Terrarium plants grow wild in the world: bromeliads, ferns and orchids in jungles, mosses and ferns in the lush caves, carnivorous plants and sedges in swamps and mangroves, cacti and succulents in deserts and badlands, grasses and aloes in savannas (#bettacraft:*_plant_lands); shears cut a cutting off (off: no new wild plants; those in the world stay)
Terrariums and paludariums
Terrarium devices
Terrarium devices: heat mat, basking lamp, mister and thermo-hygrometer (off: they do nothing; a basking lamp still shines like a light)
Terrarium and paludarium

Terrarium and paludarium: a tank without water is a terrarium, one with a land part built in the interior above the water a paludarium (terrarium.*); they get air temperature, humidity and UV, terrarium animals live there (off: every tank is an aquarium as before, no climate values) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.
Breeding of amphibians and reptiles

Breeding of the amphibians and reptiles: eggs on the land of the tank (dart frog tadpoles into the water, the leopard gecko's sex by the nest temperature; the horned frog does not breed) (off: no eggs; eggs already laid still hatch)
Amphibians and reptiles
Amphibians and reptiles in terraria and paludaria: dart frogs, horned frog, leopard gecko, crested gecko and corn snake (off: none go into tanks; those in tanks stay)
Tank type switch

Tank type switch in the tank menu: Automatic (the mode from the water and the land, as before), Aquarium, Paludarium or Terrarium; a fixed terrarium takes no water and a fixed paludarium only up to the height where its land part stays at terrarium.paludariumLandShare, from buckets, pipes, pumps, the top-off and other mods alike; water already in the tank stays (off: every tank is automatic; the chosen type is kept)
Wild amphibians and reptiles

Wild amphibians and reptiles: dart frogs and crested geckos in jungles, horned frogs in savannas and swamps, leopard geckos in deserts and badlands (#bettacraft:arid_lands), corn snakes in forests and plains (#bettacraft:snake_lands)
bettacraft.configuration.features.toolti: Switches per feature: every group has its switch enabled, sub-switches are off when their group is off; a feature that is off loses its recipes, trader offers, loot, catches and wild spawns, its items and blocks stay registered
bettacraft.configuration.features.turtle: Turtle breeding: females lay eggs into sand or soil on the land of the tank, the nest temperature decides the sex of the hatchlings (off: no eggs; eggs already laid still hatch)

Turtles in paludaria and terraria: musk turtle, slider, Hermann's tortoise, Reeves' turtle and the hatchlings of the sea turtle (off: none go into tanks, none are sold; those in tanks stay) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Sea turtles (vanilla) in big sea water paludaria: the grown ones and the hatchlings by the size rule of the big animals (1 m: 12 x 6 x 3 blocks, 100 water blocks each), from 25 ppt salt, with sand on the land, where a pair lays its eggs with features.turtles.breeding (off: no sea turtles go into tanks; those in tanks stay)
Wild turtles: sliders and musk turtles in swamps and rivers, Reeves' turtles in rivers, Hermann's tortoises in savannas and dry shrublands (#bettacraft:tortoise_lands)
bettacraft.configuration.features.visual: Lively animal movement (M54): amphibians and reptiles keep their own hours (day, night, dusk), go at a pace like the real animal with short fast phases, climb branches, rocks and leaves, hide in caves and under the decoration, bask, and do things while they sit still (a snake raises its head, flicks its tongue and coils up; lizards look around, frogs call, turtles stretch their necks), in the world as in tanks and terraria; fish dart off now and then and rest more at night, crayfish hide by day (off: the movement of 1.43)

Aquarium plants and corals with real leaves, polyps and tentacles that move in the water, inside the tank and in the miniature outside (off: the old blocks). Under Features for everyone (modpack, server), under Rendering only for you

Smooth swimming: fish turn in curves, tilt and right themselves smoothly, kuhli loaches undulate slowly like eels and hide by day, plecos and otocinclus only stand upright once they reach the glass (off: the old, jerkier movement)
Kelp, seagrass, corals (#bettacraft:swaying_plants) and the water plants of other mods sway in the miniature outside the tank like inside (off: they stand still for everyone)

Reptiles, snails and shrimp climb outside a tank (M62): turtles, the leopard gecko and the corn snake climb up one-block steps without a jump, the crested gecko climbs whole walls (the mudskipper roots and trunks), snails and shrimp that climb the glass in a tank climb walls under water (off: the vanilla jump, no wall climbing)
bettacraft.configuration.features.waterC: Water chemistry: TDS, pH and hardness from the substrate, peat, almond leaves, wood, food and water changes; every animal has its range (off: the values stand still and no animal minds them) Off: everything below is off too, and its recipes, wandering trader offers, loot, net and fishing catches and wild spawns are gone; items and blocks already in the world stay.

Oxygen as a water value: it drops with warm water, many animals and at night in planted tanks without light, and rises with air stones, sponge filters, filter outlets and flow pumps; too little stresses the animals (bettas and gouramis breathe air and hardly mind) (off: no oxygen value)

bettacraft.configuration.misterMbPerSeco: mB of water a mister uses per second while it sprays (its tank holds 4000 mB)
bettacraft.configuration.mobBreeding.too: Mobs in glass breed: two fed drowned, zombies or husks (rotten flesh) a baby, spiders (crickets) spiderlings, small slimes and magma cubes (slime ball, magma cream) a new small one; bred mobs drop nothing either
Share of its health a mob may have at most to go into the mob jar (0.25 = weakened to a quarter)
bettacraft.configuration.mobUndeadBurn.t: Undead mobs in glass (zombies, skeletons ...) burn in daylight in a tank without a lid (off: the glass protects them)
bettacraft.configuration.monitor.tooltip: Screens of monitor blocks that show every tank in range
bettacraft.configuration.mossChance.tool: Chance that shears on a moss block next to water give Java moss
Chance that a shovel on mud in a swamp turns up a trumpet snail
bettacraft.configuration.multiblockFilte: Multiblock external filter from filter chambers, a pump head and connectors, with filter media that clog and must be cleaned (off: it does not clean)
Charges the spring of a multiblock filter (its pump head) holds
Chance per allele that it mutates into a random allele
bettacraft.configuration.needHitchingPos: Seahorses are stressed without a hitching post (aquarium plants, corals or decoration that stick up in the tank interior) to hold on to with their tail
bettacraft.configuration.nestBuildDays.t: Days the male needs to build the bubble nest
Chance that the aquarium net catches something in fitting open water
bettacraft.configuration.netCooldownTick: Ticks before the aquarium net can try again in open water
bettacraft.configuration.netFishShare.to: Share of the catches of the aquarium net in jungle, swamp and river water that are tankmate fish instead of small animals (0 = no fish)
bettacraft.configuration.netPlantShare.t: Share of the aquarium net's catches in rivers, jungle water and swamps that is an aquarium plant from the bottom (times critters.netChance; 0 = the net brings up no plants)
bettacraft.configuration.netPlantsJungle: Plants the net brings up in jungle water: entries "plant_id=weight" (item ids without "bettacraft:"); empty = none
Plants the net brings up in rivers: entries "plant_id=weight" (item ids without "bettacraft:"); empty = none
Plants the net brings up in swamps: entries "plant_id=weight" (item ids without "bettacraft:"); empty = none
bettacraft.configuration.nitrateLethalFr: From this nitrate (mg/L) the water counts as bad: the animals get sick and in the end die (only after many weeks without a water change)
bettacraft.configuration.nitrateStressFr: From this nitrate (mg/L) the fish breed less, the algae grow faster and the tank log warns (the recommended water changes keep a normally stocked tank below 40)
bettacraft.configuration.oceanWaterIsSal: An empty bucket filled in an ocean or at a beach gives a bucket of sea water (for reef tanks; it pours like water)
bettacraft.configuration.offerDays.toolt: In-game days an aquarist waits for an answer before he leaves again (counts as a refusal)
bettacraft.configuration.oldAge.tooltip: Death of old age (off by default)
Charges the spring of the pressure pump of a reverse osmosis unit holds
bettacraft.configuration.otherMutationCh: Chance per gene and birth that a shrimp, crayfish, snail or a tankmate without its own genetics mutates (bettas: breeding.mutationChance, guppies and endlers 0.4 %)
bettacraft.configuration.outgrown.toolti: An animal of another mod that grew bigger than the largest animal while it lived in a tank (a young animal of a big species): BAG_IN_FRONT = it is put into a fish bag that drops in front of the tank, KEEP = it stays
Air stones and sponge filters one air pump drives at full strength (more share its air and bubble less)
bettacraft.configuration.overcrowdedPerW: Adults per water block from which health starts to drop
bettacraft.configuration.overdoseAlgae.t: Algae growth at twice the overdose level (3 = three times as fast; in between it rises smoothly)
bettacraft.configuration.overdoseAt.tool: Level from which the tank is overdosed (1.5 = 150 %): more brings no more growth, but the algae grow faster
bettacraft.configuration.overlayProvider: Which overlay mod shows the Bettacraft lines (tank, betta, filter, culture): AUTO = only the first installed one in the order Jade, WTHIT, The One Probe (no doubled boxes with two overlay mods); JADE, TOP or WTHIT = only that one; ALL = every installed one
bettacraft.configuration.oxygenPerAnimal: Oxygen one adult fish uses per day, in mg/L for one water block (at 25 °C; warmer water doubles it every 10 °C)
bettacraft.configuration.oxygenStressBel: Below this oxygen (mg/L) fish, shrimp and crayfish are stressed (snails a little, frogs not at all)
bettacraft.configuration.paludariumLandS: A tank with water is a paludarium from this share of land on (interior columns whose top is above the water)
bettacraft.configuration.panelBoost.tool: Extra light of an LED panel over the light bar (light 15 + this, on the share of the tank it covers)
bettacraft.configuration.peatBlocks.tool: Water blocks a chamber with filter peat keeps clean (peat softens the water later, M25)
bettacraft.configuration.pelletsOnLeaves: Share of the feeder's food that stays on the leaves under a full cover and rots (starts at the dense cover, 0 = off)
bettacraft.configuration.pipeUpTo.toolti: Fertilizer that comes in through a pipe (from the fertilizer maker) fills the tank only up to this level
bettacraft.configuration.pipes.tooltip: Glass and stainless steel pipes and the water pump: they carry water with its values between tanks, filters and the tanks and pipes of other mods (off: pipes carry nothing and pumps stand still)
bettacraft.configuration.plantBreedingBo: A well planted tank (plants of at least 3% of the water volume) makes a male ready for a nest this many times faster (1 = off)
bettacraft.configuration.plantFishingCha: Chance that fishing in a jungle, river or swamp brings up an aquarium plant instead of the catch
bettacraft.configuration.plantGrowthSpee: Growth speed of aquarium plants (1 = normal, 0 = they never grow or spread)
bettacraft.configuration.plantHumidity.t: Percent humidity land fully covered with plants adds in a closed tank
bettacraft.configuration.plantMeshes.too: Aquarium plants and corals with real leaves, polyps and tentacles that move in the water, inside the tank and in the miniature outside (off: the old blocks). Under Features for everyone (modpack, server), under Rendering only for you
bettacraft.configuration.plantOxygen.too: Oxygen a densely planted tank makes per day in full light, in mg/L (at night the plants use a quarter of it)
bettacraft.configuration.plantUptake.too: How much nitrate a densely planted tank in good light takes up, times the nitrate a normally stocked tank makes (1.2: dense plants keep such a tank clean on their own)
Level the plants use per day for each block of growing plants per water block (dense tanks use it faster)
bettacraft.configuration.plantWasteUptak: Water quality per in-game day taken up per tank block of plant mass (4096 plant blocks at scale 16) and water block, with light (0 = off)
bettacraft.configuration.plantsSpread.to: Whether full-grown stem plants, Vallisneria, Monte Carlo and Cryptocoryne form side shoots and runners
bettacraft.configuration.poorFoodFedDays: A meal of a food that suits the species badly counts as eaten this many days ago (it is hungry again sooner)
bettacraft.configuration.poorTubifexStre: Days of bad-water stress a fish gets from one meal of tubifex from a foul dish (0 = harmless)
bettacraft.configuration.portionWaterBlo: Water blocks one portion (a fifth of a bottle, 50 mB) brings to the right level (100 %)
bettacraft.configuration.pouchDays.toolt: Days a male seahorse carries the eggs in his brood pouch before the fry are born
bettacraft.configuration.power.tooltip: The devices can need Forge Energy (FE) (power.costs); every tank has one energy store for all its devices, charged by cables or the crank
bettacraft.configuration.predatorAttacks: Attacks per in-game day of a predator (#bettacraft:predators) on small inhabitants
bettacraft.configuration.preparationBudg: Server time per tick in milliseconds for building new interiors in the background (more = ready sooner, less = smoother ticks)
bettacraft.configuration.preset.tooltip: A ready-made profile for the whole mod: CUSTOM = none; SIMPLE = no water chemistry, CO2 or reverse osmosis, no forced water changes, no evaporation, no power, gentler care; REALISTIC = everything on, strict values, devices need FE; DECOR = no care (nothing gets hungry, sick or dies), no chemistry, power, algae or breeding. Values still at their default follow it, values you changed win. In a running game /reload brings the recipes up to date
bettacraft.configuration.presetKeep.tool: Paths that keep their own value although the preset sets another one, also when it is the default (e.g. features.breeding.enabled, waterchange.difficulty)
bettacraft.configuration.protectFromExpl: Break protection (switch in the tank menu) also stops explosions and pistons (false: it only stops players breaking the tank)
bettacraft.configuration.pufferSnailsPer: Snails one puffer eats per day; it prefers bladder and ramshorn snails (0 = never)
bettacraft.configuration.pufferTeethDays: Days until a puffer's teeth overgrow
Days a puffer goes without snails or hard food (shell food) before its teeth overgrow: it is stressed and refuses soft food until it cracks a snail or hard food again (0 = off)
bettacraft.configuration.pumpFePerPortio: Live food pump FE per portion
FE the live food pump needs per portion while pipes.pumpsRequireEnergy is on
bettacraft.configuration.pumpFePerTick.t: FE per tick of a running water pump or filter pump head at 100 % (a water change costs this per 100 mB)
Water blocks one flow pump moves enough for the corals that need strong flow
bettacraft.configuration.pumpRate.toolti: mB per tick a water pump moves at 100 %
Whether the water quality changes at all and stresses bettas when it is bad
bettacraft.configuration.range.tooltip: Blocks from a monitor within which it finds the tanks (nearest point of the tank)
bettacraft.configuration.readyDays.toolt: Days a healthy, fed pair needs in breeding conditions before the male starts a nest (live food halves it)
Sick days removed per good day
bettacraft.configuration.reefNetFishShar: Share of the catches of the aquarium net in warm and lukewarm oceans that are reef fish instead of small animals (0 = no fish)
bettacraft.configuration.referenceFishPe: Adult fish per water block of a normally stocked tank (more fish make nitrate faster, fewer slower)
bettacraft.configuration.refugiumNitrate: Nitrate (mg/L in one water block) one Chaetomorpha in a lit refugium takes up per day
bettacraft.configuration.refuseDeadlyWat: Refuse to put an animal into water whose salinity would kill it (a message tells why)
bettacraft.configuration.refuseHostile.t: Refuse hostile mobs (spawn category monster, e.g. the Cataclysm lionfish) unless they are always allowed
bettacraft.configuration.remineraliserPp: TDS (ppm) one remineralising salt adds to 1000 mB of water
bettacraft.configuration.render.tooltip: Rendering of tanks, fish and interior miniatures
bettacraft.configuration.returnDaysMax.t: Most in-game days after a refusal until the next aquarist comes (a random day between the two)
bettacraft.configuration.returnDaysMin.t: Fewest in-game days after a refusal (or after an aquarist left) until the next one comes; another breeding is needed too
bettacraft.configuration.roMembraneBucke: Buckets of reverse osmosis water a membrane makes before it is worn out
bettacraft.configuration.roPrefilterBuck: Buckets of reverse osmosis water a prefilter cartridge lasts
bettacraft.configuration.roPumpBoost.too: How much faster the FE pressure pump makes it (only while a power option is on and it has FE)
bettacraft.configuration.roPumpFe.toolti: FE per tick of the pressure pump
bettacraft.configuration.roRate.tooltip: mB of reverse osmosis water per tick without a pressure pump (it simply runs on the water it gets)
Parts of waste water for each part of reverse osmosis water (it leaves through a pipe or the drain)
bettacraft.configuration.salinityShock.t: How fast the wrong salinity harms animals (1 = a freshwater fish dies within a few hours in sea water, a few ppt too much only stress it; 0 = salinity does no harm)
bettacraft.configuration.saltwater.toolt: Salinity, protein skimmers, flow pumps, live rock, corals
bettacraft.configuration.seahorses.toolt: Seahorses (lined seahorse Hippocampus erectus, dwarf seahorse H. zosterae) at the wandering trader and in the aquarium net in warm and lukewarm oceans (off: no new ones; seahorses already caught stay)
bettacraft.configuration.shoalStress.too: Shoaling fish in a group smaller than their species' minimum are stressed (and get sick after a while)
bettacraft.configuration.shortSidePerMet: Blocks of the shorter horizontal side of a tank per metre of the animal's length (a 1 m shark: 6)
bettacraft.configuration.showAlarmWaypoi: A waypoint on your map at a tank of yours (or one you are a user of) whose monitor alarm went off or whose hired aquarist warns, until it clears. Off: none from any tank. Each tank also has its own switch in the users tab of its menu; the pack switch features.compat.journeymap turns them off for everyone
Breeding speed of the Neocaridina shrimp (1 = normal, 0 = never)
bettacraft.configuration.shrimpFoodFacto: Shrimp food gives the shrimp, crayfish and snails this many times the food of a leftover pellet
bettacraft.configuration.shrimpPerFish.t: Shrimp that count as one fish for the stocking
bettacraft.configuration.signScale.toolt: Size of the tank name sign: factor on the default text height of 0.12 blocks (0.5 to 2)
bettacraft.configuration.simulateUnloade: If true, time passes for tanks in unloaded chunks (catch-up on load). Default: time stands still.
bettacraft.configuration.skimmerBlocks.t: Water blocks one protein skimmer keeps clean in salt water (it does nothing in fresh water)
bettacraft.configuration.snailBreeding.t: Breeding speed of the snails that breed in fresh water (1 = normal, 0 = never; nerites never breed)
bettacraft.configuration.snailsPerFish.t: Snails that count as one fish for the stocking
bettacraft.configuration.spawnPassCritte: Wild small animals per player at most

The own spawn pass only spawns shrimp, snails, crayfish and hermit crabs while fewer than this many wild ones live within 48 blocks of the player (one own try per pass, preferring shallow water; 0 = it spawns none)
bettacraft.configuration.spawnPassInterv: Ticks between two tries of the own spawn pass per player (20 ticks = 1 second)
bettacraft.configuration.spawnPassPerPla: Wild fish per player at most
The own spawn pass only spawns fish, frogs and turtles while fewer than this many of them live within 48 blocks of the player (0 = it spawns none; the small animals have their own limit)
bettacraft.configuration.spongeBlocks.to: Water blocks a chamber with a filter sponge (mechanical) keeps clean
bettacraft.configuration.spongeFilterBlo: Water blocks one sponge filter keeps clean (it needs air from an air pump)
bettacraft.configuration.spongeFilterExc: Oxygen exchange of one running sponge filter, in water blocks per day
bettacraft.configuration.springTicks.too: Ticks of work a fully wound spring gives (24000 = one in-game day)
bettacraft.configuration.stages.tooltip: Duration of the life stages in in-game days
bettacraft.configuration.stationFe.toolt: FE per tick of the compressor of the CO2 filling station while it fills (only while a power option is on)
bettacraft.configuration.stationTicksPer: Ticks a CO2 filling station needs to fill a cylinder from the flue gas of one burning furnace, smoker, blast furnace or campfire (more burning fires fill faster)
bettacraft.configuration.steelLeaderChan: Chance per catch with a fishing rod and a steel leader in the other hand to hook a big animal of that water instead (an empty transport tub must be in the inventory)
bettacraft.configuration.steelPipeRate.t: mB per tick a stainless steel pipe network carries (a network of both kinds carries what its weakest pipe carries)
bettacraft.configuration.stocking.toolti: How many small animals count as one fish
bettacraft.configuration.storePerCabinet: FE every cabinet block under the tank (and every cabinet joined to them) adds to the tank's store
bettacraft.configuration.storePerWaterBl: FE the tank's store holds per water block of the tank (80000: a full store runs a 2x2x2 tank with filter, light and a heater that heats one in-game day on EASY)
bettacraft.configuration.stressPerFe.too: Stress units (SU) an input costs for every FE per tick it gives (2: 128 FE/t cost 256 SU)
bettacraft.configuration.subadultDays.to: Subadult, then the betta is adult
bettacraft.configuration.subadultStockin: How much of a fish one subadult counts for the stocking
bettacraft.configuration.substrateCostsB: Setting a floor texture consumes one block
bettacraft.configuration.sumpWaterBlocks: Water blocks a sump in a cabinet adds to the tank above (the waste, the nitrate and the dosed values spread over it, and it counts for the stocking)
bettacraft.configuration.sunUv.tooltip: UV index of sunlight through an open top (glass and lids block it)
bettacraft.configuration.surfaceExchange: Oxygen exchange of the still water surface per day, times top blocks / water blocks
bettacraft.configuration.swayingPlants.t: Kelp, seagrass, corals and the water plants of other mods sway in the miniature outside the tank, the roots of the floating plants in the water (off: they stand still, only for you)
bettacraft.configuration.syncRange.toolt: Players within this many blocks of a tank receive its miniature
bettacraft.configuration.tadpoleDays.too: Days a tadpole needs (with fine food) to become a froglet
bettacraft.configuration.tadpoles.toolti: A tadpole in a tank that grows up: LEAVE_AS_FROG = the frog hops out in front of the tank, STAY_TADPOLE = it stays a tadpole while it lives in a tank
bettacraft.configuration.tankDetailDista: Distance in blocks up to which the name sign, bubble nest, floating plants, small animals, algae and filter hoses of a tank are drawn
bettacraft.configuration.tankEdgeWidth.t: Width of the dark edge lines along the outer edges of a tank, in pixels (1/16 block): 0 = no edge lines, otherwise 0.1 to 1
bettacraft.configuration.tankmateBreedin: How readily the tankmates spawn or get pregnant (1 = normal, 0 = never)
bettacraft.configuration.tankmateStockin: Multiplies how much each tankmate counts for the stocking (a neon 0.35, a bristlenose 1.2, a clown loach 2.5 fish at 1)
bettacraft.configuration.tankmates.toolt: Tankmate fish: breeding, getting along, food
bettacraft.configuration.tauDays.tooltip: Time constant (in-game days) of the exponential approach of the water to its equilibrium temperature
bettacraft.configuration.tdsPerDay.toolt: TDS (ppm) a normally stocked tank gains per day from food and waste (water changes bring it back near the 250 of normal water)
bettacraft.configuration.terrarium.toolt: Terrarium and paludarium: a tank without water is a terrarium, one with a land part built in the interior above the water a paludarium (terrarium.*); they get air temperature, humidity and UV, terrarium animals live there (off: every tank is an aquarium as before, no climate values)
bettacraft.configuration.terrariumLandSh: A tank with water is a terrarium (the water is only a dish) from this share of land on; without water it is always a terrarium
bettacraft.configuration.ticksPerBatch.t: Ticks the food maker needs for one batch
Ticks of one device's work in one charge (24000 = one in-game day)
bettacraft.configuration.title: Bettacraft Configuration
bettacraft.configuration.toleratedMax.to: Highest water temperature (C) bettas tolerate; warmer water stresses them
bettacraft.configuration.toleratedMin.to: Lowest water temperature (C) bettas tolerate; colder water stresses them (the best range is the breeding range)
bettacraft.configuration.tracePerMl.tool: Trace elements (share of the full level in one water block) one mL of trace element solution adds
Trace elements (share of the full level) a salt water tank uses up per day
How strongly the water of a tank on a Create contraption or an airship sloshes when it speeds up, brakes or takes a curve: the surface tilts and waves run over it (0 = off: flat water as in a standing tank, 1 = natural, 2 = twice as much)
bettacraft.configuration.tubSlowness.too: How much slower a player walks while carrying a transport tub with an animal (0.35 = 35 % slower)
bettacraft.configuration.tubifexConditio: How many times as long as other live food tubifex condition a breeding fish
bettacraft.configuration.tubifexDays.too: In-game days a fed tubifex dish needs to grow from a tenth to nine tenths of its room
bettacraft.configuration.tubifexRoom.too: Portions of tubifex a full dish holds
bettacraft.configuration.unpaidDaysUntil: In-game days without wage (or without a bed and a workplace) after which an aquarist leaves
bettacraft.configuration.unpaidWorkSpeed: How fast an aquarist works while his wage is missing (1 = as fast as when paid)
bettacraft.configuration.useVanilla.tool: Use Minecraft's own sounds for the devices (bubble columns, water, beacon hum, clicks) instead of the Bettacraft sounds of the filters, air pump, air stones, sponge filter, flow pump and feeder
bettacraft.configuration.vanillaCoralsNe: Vanilla corals and coral fans in a tank interior die in fresh water (off: they live in every tank, as before)
bettacraft.configuration.varietyDays: Days a fish remembers its food
bettacraft.configuration.varietyDays.too: In-game days a fish remembers what it ate
bettacraft.configuration.varietyGroups: Food kinds for a varied diet
bettacraft.configuration.varietyGroups.t: Food groups (pellets, flakes, granules, wafers, frozen, live) a fish must have eaten in that time for a varied diet
bettacraft.configuration.varietyRecovery: How many times as fast a fish with a varied diet recovers from stress and sickness
bettacraft.configuration.wage.tooltip: Whether an aquarist wants a wage each in-game day (emeralds or food from a chest next to his workplace); without it he works for nothing and never leaves for lack of pay
bettacraft.configuration.wageEmeralds.to: Emeralds an aquarist takes as his wage each in-game day (0: he takes only food)
bettacraft.configuration.wageFood.toolti: Food items (bread, cooked fish ...) an aquarist takes instead each in-game day when there are no emeralds (0: emeralds only)
bettacraft.configuration.walkAnimationBo: Leg movement of mobs and animals walking in tanks and terraria: they walk slowly there and the mobs in glass are shrunk, so vanilla barely moves their legs (they glide). auto = matched to their size (1.5 for shrunk mobs, 3 for animals in real size), a number from 0.1 to 10 = that factor for all, 0 = like vanilla
bettacraft.configuration.wasteUptake.too: Water quality per in-game day the plants take up for each block of leaf area per water block, while they have light (0 = off)
bettacraft.configuration.waterChangeCool: Fresh water has the ambient temperature: a water change cools a heated tank down a little
bettacraft.configuration.waterChangerCha: Charges the spring of a water change controller holds (a charge is a day of a pump's work)
bettacraft.configuration.waterHeadroom.t: Air gap below the top glass of a full tank in 1/16 block (same amount of water, it only looks less full); 0 = water up to the rim
bettacraft.configuration.waterHumidity.t: Percent humidity a closed tank full of water surface adds (more when the water is warm)
bettacraft.configuration.waterPerCubicMe: Water blocks of the full tank per big animal and cubic metre of its length (a 1 m shark 100, a 2.6 m dolphin 1758)
bettacraft.configuration.waterPumpCharge: Charges the spring of a water pump holds
bettacraft.configuration.waterQuality.to: Waste of the animals and of uneaten food lowers the water quality, filters slow that down, a water change brings it back
bettacraft.configuration.waterSurfaceAni: Animated glitter on the tank water surface
bettacraft.configuration.weight.tooltip: Spawn weight of wild bettas in #bettacraft:betta_spawn_biomes (swamps); 0 disables natural spawning
bettacraft.configuration.wildCritterWeig: Spawn weight of wild small animals
Spawn weight of wild shrimp, crayfish, snails and hermit crabs crawling on the bottom of their waters; 0 disables them
bettacraft.configuration.wildCrittersNea: Wild small animals nearby at most
Wild shrimp, crayfish, snails and hermit crabs only spawn while fewer than this many of them live within 32 blocks
Wild tankmate fish and frogs only spawn while fewer than this many of them live within 32 blocks (keeps them rare, in small shoals)
Spawn weight of the wild tankmate fish and dwarf clawed frogs in their biomes, in tenths of their net catch weight; 0 disables them
bettacraft.configuration.wildPlantFreque: A factor on the chance of a wild plant group per chunk (1 = about one small group in every two or three chunks with water of their kind; 0 = none)
bettacraft.configuration.winding.tooltip: Winding with the crank (features.power.winding). With power.costs OFF only the food maker and the fertilizer maker have a spring; with EASY or HARD also the multiblock filter, reverse osmosis unit, water change controller and water pump (devices without a tank). The cabinet under a tank and an attached external filter charge the tank's store instead (power.crankFePerClick). FE goes first. One charge is one in-game day of one device's work; the spring stands still in unloaded chunks
bettacraft.configuration.windsToFull.too: Clicks with the crank that wind the spring fully (holding the crank clicks about five times a second)
bettacraft.configuration.workRadius.tool: Blocks around his workplace (the breeding basin) in which an aquarist looks after tanks
bettacraft.configuration.xaerosMinimap.t: Put the alarm waypoints into Xaero's Minimap and its World Map (when it is installed)

info.bettacraft.acropora:
Stony coral (SPS): a bush of thin blue-violet branches with pale tips; the most demanding coral.
On reef rock in a reef tank. Light: strong, flow: strong, needs calcium and clean water.
Frag it with shears; wild colonies grow on the warm ocean reefs (shears cut frags off them), rarely a piece from the aquarium net on a reef, or from vanilla corals.
info.bettacraft.activated_carbon: Filter medium (chemical): 16 water blocks per chamber. Used up after a while: replace it. Smelted from charcoal.
info.bettacraft.active_soil:
Substrate for soft water: sneak + right-click an interior floor block with it.
It pulls the pH towards 6.2, softens the water and slowly takes up minerals: just right for bee shrimp. Freshwater plants grow up to a quarter faster on it. It keeps working, it never wears out.
Plain soil (dirt, mud ...) works only half as strongly.
info.bettacraft.agave:
A large rosette of stiff, blue-grey leaves with a spine at the tip; wants very strong light.
Dry and hot: 10-55 % humidity, 20-38 °C, very strong light. Plant it on soil, sand or gravel on the land of a terrarium or paludarium: it grows there by the light, the humidity and the air temperature, spreads (offsets around it) and keeps the air humid; in a bad climate it languishes. Outside a tank it is a decoration that does not grow.
Find it: in deserts, badlands and savannas.
Shears: take an offset (a small rooted plant).
info.bettacraft.air_hose: Crafting part of the air pump. Made from dried kelp or slime balls.
info.bettacraft.air_pump:
Place it next to a tank or on it: its air hose goes into the water. It drives the air stones and sponge filters in the tank interior (4 at full strength; more share the air).
Right-click or sneak + mouse wheel: power regulator (less air, quieter). With power mods and aeration.airPumpRequiresEnergy it needs 2 FE/t per air stone.
info.bettacraft.air_stone:
Place it in a tank interior. While an air pump at the tank drives it, a column of bubbles rises to the surface and brings oxygen into the water (and drives out CO2).
Right-click or sneak + mouse wheel: power regulator.
info.bettacraft.alder_cone:
Dried alder cone: like an almond leaf with a third of the tannins, it lowers the pH a little.
Right-click a tank to put it in, or lay it on the floor of a tank interior: there it keeps giving off tannins and the shrimp graze on it.
Dry birch leaves in a smoker, furnace or on a campfire.
info.bettacraft.algae_scraper:
Cleans algae off the inside of the glass of a tank. Right-click a glass face: that face is clean; sneak + right-click: the whole side of the tank.
Wears a little for every face it cleans.
Algae grow with light, waste in the water and time; snails (nerites best) and shrimp keep them down.
Craft: an iron ingot on two sticks.
info.bettacraft.algae_wafer:
Sinking algae wafer: only the bottom fish (corydoras, plecos, otocinclus, loaches) and the small animals eat it, the bettas and the midwater fish do not get it.
Crafted from dried kelp and betta pellets.
info.bettacraft.alkalinity_canister:
Alkalinity (KH) solution for the dosing pump. Stony corals use it together with the calcium; it also holds the pH of salt water up.
Below 6 dKH they slow down, below 3 they stop.
info.bettacraft.almond_leaf:
Dried catappa leaf: its tannins lower the pH a little (blackwater) and fade within about a week.
One leaf per water block colours the water fully.
Laid on the floor of a tank interior it keeps giving off tannins (about half as many) and the shrimp graze on it.
Dry jungle leaves in a smoker, furnace or on a campfire.
info.bettacraft.aloe_vera:
A succulent with thick, grey-green leaves with soft teeth on their rims.
Dry and hot: 10-55 % humidity, 20-38 °C, strong light. Plant it on soil, sand or gravel on the land of a terrarium or paludarium: it grows there by the light, the humidity and the air temperature, spreads (offsets around it) and keeps the air humid; in a bad climate it languishes. Outside a tank it is a decoration that does not grow.
Find it: in savannas; from the aquarist.
Shears: take an offset (a small rooted plant).
info.bettacraft.alternanthera_reineckii:
A stem plant with deep red leaves; needs strong light.
Plant it in a tank interior on substrate; grows up to the water surface. From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 3.5 days to full size with strong light (a lit tank light), nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: the aquarium net in swamps, jungle water and rivers, rarely fishing in swamps, the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Full-grown it forms side shoots; at the surface it shades the tank.
info.bettacraft.amazon_frogbit:
A floating plant with round leaves and long roots hanging into the water. Males like to build their bubble nest under a cluster of frogbit most of all.
Grows with light and nutrients, forms offshoots and takes up waste.
Find it: the wandering trader sells it, fishing in swamps.
Take plants out: right-click the surface with an empty hand or an aquarium net; net + sneak thins the whole tank out by half.

Plant it in a tank interior on substrate (the interior floor with a substrate, sand, gravel or dirt). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 7 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: the aquarium net in jungle water (sometimes in rivers), rarely fishing in jungles, the wandering trader; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out.

info.bettacraft.artemia_culture: Hatches into artemia nauplii after one in-game day, but only in light (level 9 or more).
info.bettacraft.artemia_cysts:
Dried brine shrimp eggs, found now and then when you mine sand.
One jar is one artemia culture or one batch of the artemia hatchery. Jars stack to 64.
info.bettacraft.artemia_hatchery:
Hatches artemia nauplii in the light (level 9 or more).
Pour in salt water bottles, add artemia cysts and glass bottles (also by hopper; emptied salt water bottles are reused).
A batch takes 1 day. Take the nauplii with an empty hand or let a hopper below take them.
info.bettacraft.artemia_nauplii: Food for fry in the second half of the fry stage. One bottle feeds 20 fry.

Catch bettas in swamps with a water bucket or a fish bag.
info.bettacraft.betta_pellets:

Right-click a tank with it or put it into a feeder.
info.bettacraft.betta_spawn_egg: Spawns a betta with random domestic genes.
info.bettacraft.bio_co2:
Place it next to a tank or on it. Fill it: a water bucket, up to four sugar, then yeast.
It ferments for about four days (less sugar: shorter) and gives about one bubble per second - weak and uneven, day and night.
When it is spent, set it up again. Needs no power. Sneak + empty hand: pour it out.

info.bettacraft.breeding_basin:
A small glass basin with gravel, water and plants on a wooden stand: the workplace of the aquarist villager.
Place it in a village: an unemployed villager nearby becomes an aquarist. He sells food, floating and aquarium plants, shrimp, snails, test kits, substrate and live food cultures, and as a master a pair of a rare bred variety of a tankmate.
He buys grown bettas (bucket or fish bag) and bred tankmates (fish bag): the more rare genes, the more emeralds (data/<ns>/bettacraft/aquarist_prices.json).
Decoration only: nothing lives in it. Config features.sources.aquaristVillager.
info.bettacraft.breeding_box:

At most 20 young (config tankmates.breeding.breedingBoxCapacity). Take it out in the tank menu (breeding tab); the young in it swim free.

Frag it with shears; wild colonies grow on the warm ocean reefs (shears cut frags off them), more frags from the aquarium net on a reef, vanilla corals or the wandering trader.

info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_pink_lady:
Greenish leaves that turn white and pink only under strong light (best an LED panel or a high-power LED).
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 24 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: rarely when fishing in rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_snow_white:
Also sold as 'Biblis': greenish leaves that turn almost white only under strong light (best an LED panel or a high-power LED).
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 26 days to full size with medium light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: rarely when fishing in rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.bucephalandra_theia:
Bright green, slightly wavy leaves on a compact rhizome.
Plant it in a tank interior on stone or wood (rocks, roots, decoration). From a cutting it grows into a plant of many blocks, about 20 days to full size with little light, nutrients (waste in the water) and 20-30 °C, also while nobody is inside.
Find it: fishing in rivers, sometimes the aquarium net in rivers; cuttings from trimming.
Shears: trim it (cuttings), inside or from outside on the tank where you look. Break the root: take the whole plant out. Break a rhizome piece to divide it (half of it as an item).
info.bettacraft.bulkhead: Use it on a floor block of a tank: its connection appears on the interior floor. Build on with interior pipes to an intake strainer, lily pipe, nozzle or spray bar.
